title: bath and body works diffusers
text: bath and body works diffusers. Yeah.  These don't last forever and I needed to replace a few for the holiday scent show in my house.  I have several different bath and body diffusers, however, I always come back to these basic diffusers because they are compact and effective.  The fancier ones take so much space and stick out so far from the wall.  These are perfect.

product_metadata.title: Bath & Body Works White Flower Top Wallflower Plug In Diffuser -- Set of THREE (3) Home Fragrance Wallflower Plugs
features: White Flower-Top Wallflower Plug Fragrance Diffusers -- use with all Bath & Body Works Wallflower Refill Bulbs.
Pair any diffuser with your favorite Wallflower Fragrance Refill to refresh an entire room. (Refills sold separately)
Your receive THREE (3) wallflower plugs so you can fill your home with more of your favorite fragrance than ever before!
